serverInfo.name: apex-web
serverInfo.description: A real browser for your agent. page_extract renders one URL in headless Chrome with JavaScript executed and returns clean text, headings and links; site_extract reads up to 25 pages of one site in a single call, obeying robots.txt. No API key or account: $0.009 a page or $0.14 for up to 25 pages over x402 (USDC on Base, Solana or Arc, or XNT on X1), and a failed render is not charged.
